description: This source file defines SwiftUI views and supporting shapes for rendering chat messages, including message bubbles, tool call cards, typing indicators, and assistant message streams within a chat UI. It handles visual styling, shape drawing, and content rendering logic for a chat interface, particularly focusing on message presentation with tail shapes and various message states.

classes.name: ChatBubbleShape
classes.description: A custom shape representing chat message bubbles, including optional tail shapes pointing left or right.

classes.name: ChatMessageBubble
classes.description: A view displaying a chat message with appropriate styling and shape based on sender.

classes.name: ChatMessageBody
classes.description: Internal view handling the rendering of message content, including markdown, attachments, and tool calls.

classes.name: AttachmentRow
classes.description: A view representing a file attachment within a chat message.

classes.name: ToolCallCard
classes.description: A view showing details of a tool call within the chat, including name and summary.

classes.name: ToolResultCard
classes.description: A view presenting the results of a tool execution, with toggle for full or truncated view.

classes.name: ChatTypingIndicatorBubble
classes.description: A view representing a typing indicator with animated dots.

classes.name: ChatStreamingAssistantBubble
classes.description: A view displays an ongoing assistant message, possibly with a markdown variant.

classes.name: ChatPendingToolsBubble
classes.description: A view indicating tools currently being executed.

classes.name: ChatAssistantTextBody
classes.description: Internal view rendering assistant message text segments with markdown and styling.

methods.name: inset(by:)
methods.description: Returns a copy of the shape inset by the specified amount.

methods.name: path(in:)
methods.description: Constructs a Path representing the chat bubble shape with tail, based on rect.

methods.name: addBottomEdge(path:bubbleMinX:bubbleMaxX:bubbleMaxY:radius:)
methods.description: Helper method to add bottom edge curves to the shape.
